_note: 學習路徑內容第22批 #3／6：受格關係代名詞的省略（eng.t_mid.relcl.omission，會考級／中階）。限定關係子句中，當關代是子句的受詞（the book (that) I read）或介系詞受詞且介系詞留句尾（the house (that) we live in）時可省略；主格關代（the girl who sings）不可省；非限定（逗號）子句的關代不可省。誘答鎖『省略主格關代／省略後又補受詞代名詞／主格誤用 whom／非限定子句省略關代』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rom_）。

units.title_zh: 受格關係代名詞的省略
units.can_do: 我能在限定關係子句中，當關代是子句受詞或介系詞受詞（介系詞留句尾）時省略它，並知道主格關代與非限定子句的關代不可省略。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In a defining relative clause, the relative pronoun (that/which/who(m)) can be left out when it is the OBJECT of the clause: 'the book (that) I read', 'the man (whom) we met.'
claims.verification_ref: 限定子句中受格關代可省略（the book (that) I read / the man (whom) we met）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the relative pronoun is the SUBJECT of the clause, it cannot be omitted: 'the girl who sings' (not 'the girl sings').
claims.verification_ref: 主格關代不可省略（the girl who sings, not the girl sings）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the relative pronoun is the object of a preposition placed at the end, it can also be omitted: 'the house (that) we live in', 'the friend (that) I told you about.'
claims.verification_ref: 介系詞留句尾時受格關代可省略（the house (that) we live in）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In a non-defining relative clause (set off by commas) the relative pronoun cannot be omitted: 'My bike, which I bought last year, is blue.'
claims.verification_ref: 非限定（逗號）子句的關代不可省略（My bike, which I bought last year, is blue）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: In a defining relative clause, you can leave OUT the relative pronoun when it is the OBJECT (the thing the verb acts on). The movie (that) we watched was great. 當關係代名詞是子句的受詞時，可以省略。
The movie we watched last night was great.　（我們昨晚看的電影很棒。that 作 watched 的受詞，被省略了。）
But if the relative pronoun is the SUBJECT of the clause, you must keep it. The boy who broke the window ran away. 若關係代名詞是子句的主詞，不能省略。
The boy who broke the window ran away.　（打破窗戶的男孩跑走了。who 是 broke 的主詞，不能省。）
You can also drop the pronoun when it is the object of a preposition left at the end. The chair (that) you sat on is broken. 介系詞留在句尾時，受格關代也可省略。
The chair you sat on is broken.　（你坐的那張椅子壞了。that 作 on 的受詞，被省略。）

practice.stem: 下面哪一個關係子句的關係代名詞『可以省略』（因為它是子句的受詞）？
options: the cake that she made
the boy who sits near me
the bird that is singing
the people who live upstairs

distractor_rationales.the boy who sits near me: who 是子句（sits）的主詞，主格關代不能省略。
distractor_rationales.the bird that is singing: that 是子句（is singing）的主詞，主格關代不能省略。
distractor_rationales.the people who live upstairs: who 是子句（live）的主詞，主格關代不能省略。

practice.feedback: the cake (that) she made：that 是 made 的受詞，可省略。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（會說三種語言的女士是我阿姨）
practice.answer: The woman who speaks three languages is my aunt.
options: The woman who speaks three languages is my aunt.
The woman speaks three languages is my aunt.
The woman she speaks three languages is my aunt.
The woman whom speaks three languages is my aunt.

distractor_rationales.The woman speaks three languages is my a: who 是主格關代、不能省略，否則一句出現 speaks、is 兩個動詞卻無連接。
distractor_rationales.The woman she speaks three languages is: 不可用代名詞 she 代替關代，要用 who 引導子句。
distractor_rationales.The woman whom speaks three languages is: whom 是受格；這裡關代是 speaks 的主詞，要用主格 who。

practice.feedback: …who speaks three languages…：主格關代 who 不能省略。

practice.stem: 選出正確、且省略了關係代名詞的句子：（這就是我跟你說過的那位朋友）
practice.answer: This is the friend I told you about.
options: This is the friend I told you about.
This is the friend about I told you.
This is the friend I told you about him.
This is the friend who I told you about who.

要省略關代時，介系詞 about 留在句尾：the friend (that) I told you about。
about 的受詞就是被省略的關代，不再補受詞 him。
distractor_rationales.This is the friend who I told you about: 關代只出現一次；此句重複、且 about 的受詞已是前面的關代。

practice.feedback: the friend (that) I told you about：介系詞 about 留句尾、受格關代省略。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（我哥哥——你昨天見過的那位——是醫生）
practice.answer: My brother, whom you met yesterday, is a doctor.
options: My brother, whom you met yesterday, is a doctor.
My brother, you met yesterday, is a doctor.
My brother you met yesterday is a doctor.
My brother, met yesterday by you, is a doctor.

distractor_rationales.My brother, you met yesterday, is a doct: 非限定（逗號）子句的關代不能省略，要保留 whom／who。
distractor_rationales.My brother you met yesterday is a doctor: 題幹破折號標示非限定（補充說明）子句，此時要前後加逗號、且關代 whom／who 不能省略。
distractor_rationales.My brother, met yesterday by you, is a d: 這改成了被動分詞、不是原意的關係子句；應用 whom you met yesterday。

practice.feedback: My brother, whom you met yesterday, …：非限定子句關代不能省略。

practice.stem: 選出『省略關係代名詞後仍正確』的句子：（他給我的禮物很棒）
practice.answer: The gift he gave me was wonderful.
options: The gift he gave me was wonderful.
The gift gave me was wonderful.
The gift he gave me it was wonderful.
The gift which gave me was wonderful.

省略的是受格關代，但主詞 he 不能省；要有 he gave me。
受格關代省略後不再補 it；he gave me 後不加 it。
這讓 which 變成 gave 的主詞、語意變成『禮物給我』；原意關代是受詞，應省略或用 which he gave me。

practice.feedback: The gift (that) he gave me…：受格關代省略、主詞 he 保留。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The restaurant we tried last week was excellent.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：The restaurant we tried（省略 that）、last week、excellent、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。省略關代處連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: The friend I called last night is coming over.
lines.intonation: friend I called 連讀、over 句尾下收

lines.text: Here is the book you lent me.
lines.intonation: book you lent me 連讀、me 句尾下收
